fixtures.name: li
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT CASE (i % 3) WHEN 0 THEN 'A' WHEN 1 THEN 'N' ELSE 'R' END AS rf, CASE WHEN i % 13 = 4 THEN NULL WHEN (i // 3) % 2 = 0 THEN 'F' ELSE 'O' END AS ls, CASE WHEN i % 23 = 1 THEN NULL ELSE ((i * 31) % 50 + 1)::DECIMAL(15,2) END AS q, CASE WHEN i % 17 = 3 THEN NULL ELSE ((90091 + (i * 7919) % 10404859) / 100.0)::DECIMAL(15,2) END AS p, CASE WHEN i % 19 = 5 THEN NULL ELSE ((i * 5) % 11 / 100.0)::DECIMAL(15,2) END AS d, CASE WHEN i % 29 = 7 THEN NULL ELSE ((i * 3) % 9 / 100.0)::DECIMAL(15,2) END AS t, (i % 1000)::DECIMAL(9,2) AS c, DATE '1992-01-01' + (i % 2526)::INTEGER AS sd FROM range(300000) r(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 100000)

fixtures.name: wide
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT CASE i % 2 WHEN 0 THEN 'x' ELSE 'y' END AS k, (CASE WHEN i < 150000 THEN 9999999999999999.99 ELSE -9999999999999999.98 END)::DECIMAL(18,2) AS v, (i % 7)::DECIMAL(18,2) AS w, (CASE WHEN i % 1000 = 7 THEN 9999999999999999.99 ELSE i % 100 END)::DECIMAL(18,2) AS s FROM range(300000) r(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 100000)
